mechanics.label: Runes
mechanics.use: Keep the right rune pair ready for Death Strike and planned cooldowns.

mechanics.label: Runic Power
mechanics.use: Reserve enough for Icebound Fortitude while feeding Rune Strike deliberately.

mechanics.label: Diseases
mechanics.use: Maintain Frost Fever and Blood Plague so Death Strike heals for its full two-disease amount.

mechanics.label: Minions
mechanics.use: Treat Raise Dead, Death Pact, and Army as controlled tools whose taunts can disrupt positioning.

talent.name: LK25H personal-survival build
talent.summary: Maximize single-target durability with Will of the Necropolis, 5/5 Anticipation, and 3/3 Frigid Dreadplate; the raid supplies the 20% melee-haste buff.
